record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> that Jeremiah<WH03414> the prophet<WH05030> spake<WH01696><WTH8765> unto Baruch<WH01263> the son<WH01121> of Neriah<WH05374>, when he had written<WH03789><WTH8800> these words<WH01697> in a book<WH05612> at the mouth<WH06310> of Jeremiah<WH03414>, in the fourth<WH07243> year<WH08141> of Jehoiakim<WH03079> the son<WH01121> of Josiah<WH02977> king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,
Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, unto thee, O Baruch<WH01263>;

Thou didst say<WH0559><WTH8804>, Woe<WH0188> is me now! for the LORD<WH03068> hath added<WH03254><WTH8804> grief<WH03015> to my sorrow<WH04341>; I fainted<WH03021><WTH8804> in my sighing<WH0585>, and I find<WH04672><WTH8804> no rest<WH04496>.

Thus shalt thou say<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, The LORD<WH03068> saith<WH0559><WTH8804> thus; Behold, <FI>that<Fi> which I have built<WH01129><WTH8804> will I break down<WH02040><WTH8802>, and that which I have planted<WH05193><WTH8804> I will pluck up<WH05428><WTH8802>, even this whole land<WH0776>.

And seekest<WH01245><WTH8762> thou great things<WH01419> for thyself? seek<WH01245><WTH8762> <FI>them<Fi> not: for, behold, I will bring<WH0935><WTH8688> evil<WH07451> upon all flesh<WH01320>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>: but thy life<WH05315> will I give<WH05414><WTH8804> unto thee for a prey<WH07998> in all places<WH04725> whither thou goest<WH03212><WTH8799>.<CM>
